title: Blob expiry and deletion on the server
description: Stage 1 of attachments (branch attach-server) stores JMAP blobs with no deletion: no expiry, no Blob/destroy, no GC of blobs no message references. An account that reaches MAX_ACCOUNT_BLOB_BYTES / MAX_ACCOUNT_BLOBS (both INVENTED) stays full. Decide a retention rule (e.g. age-based expiry, since uploaded attachments are referenced only from encrypted messages the server cannot read) and implement it in crates/mimid-server/src/store/blobs.rs.
